== Notes ==
* The enchantment is maintained on the caster, not the targeted ally.
** If the target dies, you will continue to maintain Recall.
** If you dismiss the enchantment while the target is dead, you will not shadow step nor will your skills be disabled. Once the target is resurrected, the skill will resume its normal function.
** If you die while maintaining Recall your corpse will not shadow step.
* You will step to the target if the enchantment ends because you and the target move out of [[compass range]] from each other.
{{anomaly|The full description does not state that this skill cannot self-target.}}

==Trivia==
*Recall is the only compass range shadow step-skill that does not [[teleport]] you back to a previous position.
